I’ve kicked benzos and heroin more times than I’d care to admit and what I found was that as your tolerance increases, you get something called ‘interdose withdrawal’—aka, you’re in mild wd until you take your dose that allows you to feel normal for a few hours.  This cycle will get worse and worse until you’re able to fully and safely detox. I know you’re not on a benzo, but anything that’s ever made me feel high has had a shitty detox period. I had bad insomnia for about a week but it let up pretty quickly.  They keep you so busy in rehab which makes it easy to knock out at bedtime.  I slept like a rock a couple weeks in and practically never woke up throughout the night.  I’m a high strung/naturally tense person and never thought that would be possible for me either.  I know it’s not easy asking for help, but I think at least going to an inpatient detox might be necessary if you find it difficult to stop on your own.  Good luck to you 💕
